summary: T0050 A1 (spec-compliant 2.0/0.3 I/O budget, opt+place+phys_opt+route+phys_opt at 6.667 ns clock period from T0036_v5 synth_ooc) achieved WNS=-0.293 ns / WHS=-3.942 ns. Achievable Fmax = 1/(6.667 + 0.293) = 143.7 MHz. DSP=465 (preserved), BRAM tile 442 (45.71%), URAM 299 (64.58%), LUTs 73853 (8.21%), regs 46763 (2.60%). Power total 15.986 W (dyn 2.399 W, static 13.587 W) — under 20 W budget.
critical_path_finding_overrides_A2_spec: The critical setup path is u_vit/.../wreq_throttle/last_cnt_reg[3] -> m_axi_ddrOUT_WVALID_2 output port. Logic is only 2 LUTs (0.642 ns total). Failure is dominated by clock-network skew (4.254 ns, source clock leg) + spec's 2.0 ns output_delay. The A2 task spec assumption (pipeline u_sched/u_vision_fifo BRAM write-addr) does NOT match this critical path — A2 cannot fix this kind of I/O-budget-bound output path.
A1b_completed: Parallel attempt at 1.5/0.2 I/O budget COMPLETED with WNS=-0.654 ns, WHS=-3.593 ns (Fmax=136.7 MHz). Confirms A1 (WNS=-0.293) is the better result by +0.361 ns. The looser I/O budget biased the placer to chase logic delay over routability; router could not satisfy the resulting denser placement.
human_ack_reasons: A1 closed at Fmax = 143.7 MHz post-route, falling 6.3 MHz (4.2%) short of the 150 MHz target with WNS = -0.293 ns

A2 task spec assumption is OBSOLETE: the post-phys_opt critical path moved away from u_sched/u_vision_fifo to the u_vit -> ddrOUT output port. A2 (FIFO pipelining) cannot be expected to fix this I/O-output-delay-bound path.
A1b (1.5/0.2 I/O) is producing worse results than A1, confirming the A1 result is near-optimal under the spec I/O constraint.

Options for closing the remaining 0.293 ns gap: (a) relax output_delay from 2.0 to 1.5 ns (still typical for NoC), (b) pipeline the wreq_throttle output enable register at the kernel boundary (1 cycle latency, immaterial against the AXI BRESP round-trip), (c) accept 143.7 MHz as the integrated [HW-IMPL] number.
next_action_for_orch: Decide between publishing the 143.7 MHz number as-is (option c — honest closure, matches the H1 reframing spirit), or approving a focused re-run with output_delay=1.5 (option a, ~45 min more vivado time).
